name: Trace owners of held-open episodic .bak
goal: Identify the owning session of each node PID (6421, 10935, 19201, 92160) holding the deleted 39 GiB db.sqlite.bak, for the operator's restart-vs-kill decision.

tasks.name: Trace owners and record them (O1-O5)
tasks.description: No tests required: read-only process listing; only output is a findings section. Exact commands: human plan Task 1 Steps 1-5. Output files /private/tmp/disk-shortfall/trace-*; stderr to own .err (no 2>/dev/null). NOTHING killed/signalled/changed; only ps, lsof, tmux list-panes.

steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && for p in 6421 10935 19201 92160; do echo "== $p"; lsof -p "$p" 2> "trace-lsof-$p.err" | grep -F db.sqlite.bak; echo "grep=$?"; done > trace-holders.txt; cat trace-holders.txt
steps.expected: Per PID: .bak line + grep=0, or grep=1 with .err explaining; exited PID = released.

steps.description: O2: parent chain of each PID to PPID 1
steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && for p in 6421 10935 19201 92160; do echo "== chain from $p"; c=$p; while [ -n "$c" ] && [ "$c" -gt 1 ]; do ps -o pid=,ppid=,lstart=,tty=,command= -p "$c" 2>> trace-ps.err; c=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$c" 2>> trace-ps.err | tr -d ' '); done; done > trace-chains.txt; cat trace-chains.txt
steps.expected: Each chain reaches PPID 1; node with PPID 1 = orphan.

steps.description: O3: cwd of every chain PID + tmux panes
steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && for p in $(awk '/^ *[0-9]/{print $1}' trace-chains.txt | sort -u); do lsof -a -d cwd -p "$p" -Fn 2>> trace-cwd.err | sed -n "s/^n/$p cwd=/p"; done > trace-cwd.txt; tmux list-panes -a -F '#{pane_pid} #{session_name} #{pane_current_path}' > trace-tmux.txt 2> trace-tmux.err; echo "tmux=$?"; cat trace-cwd.txt trace-tmux.txt
steps.expected: cwds recorded; chain PID matching a tmux pane_pid names its tmux session.

steps.description: O4: append '## 6. Holder owners (2026-10-12)' to docs/reviews/2026-10-12-disk-shortfall-findings.md: per PID — still holding; owning top-level process (Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT.app / tmux session / launchd orphan) + PID + start; cwd; live interactive session affected?; release options as operator decisions only (end/restart owning session; exact-PID kill if orphan or tool not needed); never pattern-kill; cite trace-* files
